description: This is the main source file for the litellm Python SDK, providing classes and functions for making asynchronous and synchronous language model API calls, including support for fallbacks, mock responses, logging, and multiple providers such as OpenAI, Azure, and others. It defines core classes like LiteLLM, Chat, and Completions, as well as functions for handling completions, streaming, mocks, fallback mechanisms, and provider configurations.
